newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas holds in West, softens in East.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas holds in West, softens in East.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were mostly steady Thursday in the West but softer in the East as storage buying continued at a fairly brisk pace and temperatures moderated, market sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked at C$1.76/1.77 per gigajoule, unchanged from Wednesday.
May AECO prices were quoted at C$1.74-1.76 per GJ, indicating a 25-cent jump from April indices.
Meanwhile, May/October business hovered around C$1.72, traders said.
